heading: Real pathways, for real destinations.
subheading: Every route into a new country is different. Start with where you're headed, or with the kind of pathway you need.

unitedStates.label: United States
unitedStates.description: Green cards, work visas, and the DV lottery — the full range of pathways to living and working in the US.

canada.label: Canada
canada.description: Express Entry, Provincial Nominee Programs, and family sponsorship into one of the world's most welcoming systems.

unitedKingdom.label: United Kingdom
unitedKingdom.description: Skilled Worker visas, family visas, and settlement routes for building a life in the UK.

australia.label: Australia
australia.description: Skilled migration, employer sponsorship, and family visas for one of the most sought-after destinations for permanent migration.

portugal.label: Portugal
portugal.description: Golden Visa and D7 passive income routes — one of Europe's most accessible paths to residency.

newZealand.label: New Zealand
newZealand.description: Skilled Migrant and family visas for one of the most consistently ranked destinations for quality of life.

greenCardLottery.label: Green Card Lottery
greenCardLottery.description: Enter the US Diversity Visa Lottery the right way, with your application checked for the mistakes that disqualify thousands of entries every year.

investorVisas.label: Investor & Golden Visas
investorVisas.description: Residency through qualifying investment, available in dozens of countries with programs built for exactly this.

familySponsorship.label: Family Sponsorship
familySponsorship.description: Bring a spouse, parent, or child to join you — guided by people who know exactly which relationship categories move fastest.

citizenship.label: Citizenship & Naturalization
citizenship.description: From residency to naturalization, we guide you through every requirement on the path to becoming a citizen.

skilledWorker.label: Skilled Worker Visas
skilledWorker.description: Points-based and employer-sponsored routes for professionals with in-demand skills.

digitalNomad.label: Digital Nomad Visas
digitalNomad.description: Live and work remotely, legally, in one of the growing number of countries built for exactly that.
